snippet.title: SNES Longplay [172] The Legend of the Mystical Ninja (2-Players)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by:  Tsunao & Genbu

Wacky game by friggin' Konami.

Kid Ying and Doctor Yang go on a grand adventure...or something.  I skipped through the beginning scene.

I control Goemon.  Bro control Ebisumaru.  No Judo skills used because they are friggin' expensive.  NO SKILLZ ENVOLVD!

From our adventure:
-bro questions something about the game-
Me:  "Don't question it!!  It is a Ganbare Goemon game!" -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
